fitment.noMake: The manual names no manufacturer, so it cannot be compared with the fleet.
fitment.noModel: The manual names no model code. {makeLine}; the manual cannot say which of them it covers.
fitment.full: Manual says {name}. {makeLine}; {recorded} of them record a model; {matches} record the model {family}.

queue.differentDescription: Same code, different description. A code can mean a different item in another country.
queue.aliasNotVerified: The OEM number on the catalogue item is not verified.
queue.manyCandidates: This ERP item matches {n} catalogue items. Pick one; none is chosen for you.
queue.taken: This catalogue item is already linked to another ERP item in this country.

loc.capacityPositive: Capacity must be a number above zero.
loc.capacityUnit: Say what the capacity is measured in.
loc.vanOnlyService: Only a service van names a vehicle.
loc.vanRequired: Name the van (its fleet asset number).
loc.mixing: More than one item in a no-mixing location

tool.calFuture: The calibration date cannot be in the future.
tool.calNextDue: Give the next due date after the calibration date.
tool.holder: Say who is taking the tool.
tool.dueBackInvalid: The due-back date is not a date.
tool.dueBackPast: The due-back date must be in the future.

lube.onlyFree: Only {free} is free on this line.
lube.asset: Choose the asset it went into.
lube.meterNumber: The meter reading must be a number.
lube.meterType: Say whether the reading is km or hours.
